en: There's a man digging a tunnel all the way from Rustboro, they say. Why would anyone do that?
The man who dug the tunnel did it all for love! He just wanted to see his girlfriend. How romantic!
Somebody keeps trying to bust through the cave over there. I can hear him hammering at night!
The tunnel's open now! It's so easy to get to Rustboro. I can go and see the big city whenever I like.
